<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ProductPrototype"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-prototype">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductPrototype" name="Product Prototype Development" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify an idea for a new product or improvement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResearchFeasibility" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility studies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select a promising design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety, and market potential"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Is refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" name="Approve for further development?" default="Flow_Discarded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved for further development"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Discarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Research" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Research_Draft" sourceRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_Select" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Build" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refinementNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Retest" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approvedForFurtherDevelopment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discarded" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description lists mutually exclusive ways to achieve an outcome: Model each stated alternative as a distinct activity on an exclusive-gateway branch, rather than combining the alternatives into one generic activity.
rules.situation: the description states that a process can conclude in one of several mutually exclusive outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description specifies multiple distinct criteria or dimensions to be evaluated for an item.: Model each distinct evaluation as a separate activity rather than combining them into one activity.
rules.situation: the description specifies multiple distinct criteria or dimensions to be evaluated for an item.

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple distinct activities together in one sentence or clause, including as a coordinated list: Represent each distinct activity as its own BPMN task, and preserve only the ordering or dependencies that the description states.
rules.situation: the description names multiple distinct activities together in one sentence or clause, including as a coordinated list

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome whose surrounding context is already clear from the process flow: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the activity or outcome, without adding explanatory context that does not distinguish it from other elements.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome whose surrounding context is already clear from the process flow

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple actions in an order and does not indicate that they occur concurrently or independently: Model the actions in the stated order using sequence flows; do not use parallel branches unless the description supports concurrent or independent execution.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that one activity follows another or depends on its completion

rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description names multiple distinct actions as stages in a sequence, including actions grouped within one sentence
